map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Henry and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-08 03:01): early in person 2,813 (state 2,742); ballots sent 14,521 (state 13,606). Clermont (as of 2026-10-08 21:19): mail returned 38 (state 27); early in person 1,971 (state 1,359). Crawford (as of 2026-10-08 15:45): early in person 414 (state 300). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-08 17:05): mail returned 207 (state 99); early in person 4,685 (state 3,291). Franklin (as of 2026-10-08 00:12): mail returned 164 (state 140); early in person 6,042 (state 5,835); ballots sent 70,585 (state 68,613). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-07 19:07): early in person 4,763 (state 4,620); ballots returned, any method 4,896 (state 4,752). Henry (as of 2026-10-08 14:46): early in person 426 (state 297). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-08 08:34): mail returned 38 (state 34).
